scope: Read-only supplementary audit: static central-axis Taihe, Zhonghe, Baohe plus Jiaotai final nameboard. Not the 77 ZoneBase hall inventory.
method: Final PalaceBuilder.buildAll scene, real production TextureLibrary with inert offline textures; inspect final preserved plaque Mesh after merge and central installers; finite bounds, unchanged baseline transform/dimensions, whole shrunken-by-0.002m volume against all other final-scene triangles. Official source photographs actually viewed. Read-only diagnostic scripts are outside project source.

results.name: 太和殿
results.source: current final buildAll scene AFTER merge and post-install adaptations; real production TextureLibrary, inert offline textures, no GPU

officialEvidence.observation: 实际查看官方匾额近照：竖式单列蓝地汉字牌，红褐曲线雕框；上端位于上檐椽下，下端临近下层屋面围脊，明确是双檐夹层，而非下层门头。
officialEvidence.photographyDate: unknown; URL date is not a capture date

decision.mountingTopologyConfidence: high for official source layer; model exact dimensions and elevations not surveyed
decision.reason: Official pixels support existing mounting class, complete final geometry has no external surface intersection, and for single-eave halls full board remains above actual door head. No evidence-backed further move identified.
residuals: Simplified rectangular plaque and system-font lettering are not the historic carved frame.
No browser/GPU rendering or physical walking-path test performed.
A set of clear CPU rays does not prove every camera angle is unobscured.

Near lower standing viewpoints can be screened by the lower projecting roof. Recorded rays are diagnostics at selected model points, not a requirement that every historic nameboard be visible from every courtyard distance.
